description: A host must truthfully declare these booleans before loading a portable team mode.

capabilities.filesystem_read: Read canonical declarations, task packets and evidence.
capabilities.filesystem_write: Write run artifacts and structured member handoffs.
capabilities.persistent_workspace: Keep one run directory across pauses and member calls.
capabilities.process_exec: Execute the local workflow guard and declared Skill scripts.
capabilities.isolated_member_invocation: Run each member in a separate model context.
capabilities.invocation_id: Expose a real unique member-call identifier.
capabilities.secret_redaction: Keep login credentials and tokens out of prompts and receipts.
capabilities.pandadata_access: Provide real PandaData access through SDK, MCP or Connector.
capabilities.human_approval_resume: Pause before costed runs and resume after explicit approval.
capabilities.pandaai_cli: Expose authenticated pandaai-cli >=0.1.6 for standard/audit paid stages.
